summary: aclade-agent runs remote-dispatched shell commands from aclade.com and auto-updates itself unpinned
details: dist/index.js long-polls https://aclade.com/api/connector/poll and executes server-supplied tasks on the installer's host. The execute_bash task type feeds the remote-controlled command string into child_process.spawn with shell: true, and additional task types (read_file, write_file, list_directory_recursive) grant arbitrary filesystem read/write on any path with the invoking user's privileges. Results are POSTed back to the same endpoint. The agent self-daemonizes to persist the poll loop in the background. In the same poll loop it hourly queries https://registry.npmjs.org/aclade-agent for the `latest` tag and, on any version mismatch, runs `npm install -g aclade-agent@latest` via child_process.execSync and exits, so whatever version the registry serves is installed globally without confirmation. The combination gives the remote party interactive full-host code execution plus an unpinned, unattended auto-update channel that will propagate any future release to every running host.
